# GrowthBook & kfzteile24 | Intro + Enterprise Overview
Date: 2026-09-23 | Duration: 38m

## Summary
The discussion covered network and meeting quality, with advice to use the least busy 2.4, 5, or 6 GHz WiFi band, preferably Ethernet, and to monitor Mac resource usage when Google Meet issues occur. GrowthBook has been newly integrated for A/B testing, beginning with a product-sorting test in the Netherlands and potentially expanding to other sales channels and company-wide use. The team is starting without an established testing process, with data involved from the beginning while PMs seek independent test management through a shared configuration. Planned testing includes UI and backend changes, with desired features such as IP exclusion, automation, and alerting. Conversion rate is the north star metric, currently about 1.5% for the shop and 25% for B2B. Enterprise capabilities discussed included role-based permissions, SSO, onboarding, SLA support, cloud or self-hosted deployment, and GDPR and ISO compliance. Pricing uses a base license plus users or experiments; approximately 10–20 users are expected, with a goal of about 10 experiments monthly. A rough cost estimate was requested because budget was needed by the end of the week.

## Keywords
GrowthBook, A/B testing, Enterprise plan, conversion rate, pricing model, data integration
